He made his dogs sit on the floor.

다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 단어의 형태가 나머지와 다른 것은?
① Ms. Lee had me ______ the report. (review)
② She let the kids ______ on the wall. (paint)
③ The song made her ______ that day. (remember)
④ He got us ______ the empty classroom. (use)
⑤ A simple mistake made him ______ confidence. (lose)
choices: Ms. Lee had me ______ the report. (review)
She let the kids ______ on the wall. (paint)

다음 두 문장이 같은 의미가 되도록 빈칸에 들어갈 말을 쓰시오.
He eats three times more than I do.
He eats ______ I do.

questions.explainKo: 정답: ③, ⑤. 보기와 같이 make + 목적어 + 동사원형(5형식)이다. ①②④는 make + 간접목적어 + 직접목적어(4형식)이다. (답지 p.29 Grammar 심화 06)
questions.promptEn:
다음 중 <보기>와 문장 구조가 같은 것을 모두 고르시오.
<보기> My mom made me wash the dishes after dinner.
① She made her son apple juice.
② My uncle made them pizza and pasta.
③ He made me do my homework before lunch.
④ I made Jake a teddy bear for his birthday.
⑤ The coach made the players go to bed early the night before the game.
choices: She made her son apple juice.
My uncle made them pizza and pasta.
He made me do my homework before lunch.
I made Jake a teddy bear for his birthday.
The coach made the players go to bed early the night before the game.

questions.promptEn:
다음 중 밑줄 친 부분을 어법상 바르게 고치지 않은 것은?
① He runs as <u>fast than</u> his friends. (→ as)
② David can dance as <u>good</u> as Lucas. (→ well)
③ The soup is as <u>spicier</u> as I expected. (→ spicy)
④ The class was as <u>more boring</u> as I thought. (→ boring)
⑤ She sings as <u>more beautifully</u> as her mother. (→ beautiful)
choices: He runs as fast than his friends. (→ as)
David can dance as good as Lucas. (→ well)
The soup is as spicier as I expected. (→ spicy)
The class was as more boring as I thought. (→ boring)
She sings as more beautifully as her mother. (→ beautiful)

questions.promptEn:
다음 빈칸 ⓐ-ⓒ에 들어갈 말이 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
They ⓐ ______ us take pictures inside the museum.
She had him ⓑ ______ the broken chair.
He made his daughter ⓒ ______ the piano every day.
choices: let / fix / practice
let / fix / practiced
made / fixed / practicing
made / fixed / to practice
got / to fix / practice

questions.promptEn:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장 두 개를 찾아 고치시오.
ⓐ It made me change my mind.
ⓑ He had his team reviewed the plan again.
ⓒ The library is not as noise as the cafeteria.
ⓓ This smartphone is twice as expensive as my old one.

(1) ⓑ를 바르게 고친 문장을 쓰시오.
accept: He had his team review the plan again.

questions.promptEn:
다음 중 어법상 틀린 문장 두 개를 찾아 고치시오.
ⓐ It made me change my mind.
ⓑ He had his team reviewed the plan again.
ⓒ The library is not as noise as the cafeteria.
ⓓ This smartphone is twice as expensive as my old one.

(2) ⓒ를 바르게 고친 문장을 쓰시오.
accept: The library is not as noisy as the cafeteria.
The library is not so noisy as the cafeteria.

questions.promptEn:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 것끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
ⓐ Let us starting the meeting.
ⓑ He always makes me feel special.
ⓒ The little boy smiled as bright as the sun.
ⓓ He explained the problem as clearly as the teacher.
ⓔ This classroom is not as warm as the one next door.

questions.promptEn:
다음 우리말에 맞도록 괄호 안의 단어를 이용하여 문장을 완성하시오.
호수의 물은 거울만큼 깨끗했다. (clear)
The water in the lake is ______ a mirror.

questions.ruleKo: 모두 고르기는 해당하는 것을 모두 누르세요. 빈칸은 그 칸만, 고친 문장은 전체를 쓰세요.

questions.explainKo: 정답: ②. 앞 문장은 돈이 건강만큼 중요하지 않다는 뜻이고, 뒤 문장은 돈이 더 중요하다는 뜻이다. (답지 p.29 Grammar 심화 12)
questions.promptEn:
다음 중 두 문장의 의미가 같지 않은 것은?
① Mike doesn't eat as fast as John.
= John eats faster than Mike.
② Money isn't as important as health.
= Money is more important than health.
③ This building is taller than that building.
= That building isn't so tall as this building.
④ The loud noise made the baby wake up.
= The baby woke up because of the loud noise.
⑤ This blue box is 8 kg. The red box is 2 kg.
= This blue box is four times as heavy as the red one.
choices: Mike doesn't eat as fast as John. = John eats faster than Mike.
Money isn't as important as health. = Money is more important than health.
This building is taller than that building. = That building isn't so tall as this building.
The loud noise made the baby wake up. = The baby woke up because of the loud noise.
This blue box is 8 kg. The red box is 2 kg. = This blue box is four times as heavy as the red one.

questions.explainKo: 정답: had the children be quiet. 사역동사 had + 목적어 + 동사원형. the children, had로 다섯 단어. (답지 p.29 Grammar 심화 13)
questions.promptEn:
그림: 미술관에서 안내원이 입술에 손가락을 대고 조용히 하라는 신호를 하고 있다. 여자아이와 가방을 멘 남자아이가 안내원을 보고 있고, 벽에는 그림과 조각상이 있다.

다음 그림을 보고, 조건에 맞게 문장을 완성하시오.
조건: the children, had를 이용하여 총 5단어로 쓸 것.

→ The guide ______.
accept: The guide had the children be quiet
The guide had the children be quiet.
